detail.longDescription: The human-agent platform where people and always-on agents get work done together in one unified, context-aware space. Unlike single-user personal agents, Teamily AI enables multi-user, multi-agent teamwork. Built on an AI-native messenger, it connects people, agents, docs, meetings, calls, workflows, and business systems to automate office work and customer service. Agents become real teammates with persistent memory, proactive intelligence, and continuous self-improvement. Free to get started.
